mediated_overlaps.rule: P02 owns contracts/** until G0; afterwards each module owns only its own fragments; anything else is a CCR resolved by M5 (P00).

P04 owns the realm template file; compose wiring stays P03 via CCR.
P06 owns tests/regulatory/** except payroll/ (P13) and map.yaml (P23).
P23 owns docs/compliance/** except the P06 and P15 files, which P23 only reviews.
P21 owns the demo tenant data file; loader code stays P01.
Append-only: each module adds only its own <module>.* codes; M5 checks the diff.
